It left him at liberty to speak with the others whose interests were much closer to his heart. To his surprise the person who came for Gus immediately addressed to him the most anxious questions about Lady Markham and Alice.

arxiv-2204-06759.title: Iterative Inner/outer Approximations for Scalable Semidefinite Programs using Block Factor-width-two Matrices
arxiv-2204-06759.creator: Feng-Yi Liao, Yang Zheng
arxiv-2204-06759.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose iterative inner/outer approximations based on a recent notion of block factor-width-two matrices for solving semidefinite programs (SDPs). Our inner/outer approximating algorithms generate a sequence of upper/lower bounds of increasing accuracy for the optimal SDP cost.

arxiv-2209-05434.title: 3DFaceShop: Explicitly Controllable 3D-Aware Portrait Generation
arxiv-2209-05434.creator: Junshu Tang, Bo Zhang, Binxin Yang, Ting Zhang, Dong Chen, Lizhuang Ma, Fang Wen
arxiv-2209-05434.description: Abstract In contrast to the traditional avatar creation pipeline which is a costly process, contemporary generative approaches directly learn the data distribution from photographs. While plenty of works extend unconditional generative models and achieve some levels of controllability, it is still challenging to ensure multi-view consistency, especially in large poses.

arxiv-2305-06258.title: The protein dynamical transition is independent of hydration
arxiv-2305-06258.creator: Johanna Kölbel, Moritz L. Anuschek, Ivonne Stelzl, Supawan Santitewagun, Wolfgang Frieß, J. Axel Zeitler
arxiv-2305-06258.description: Abstract Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy and differential scanning calorimetry were used to study the role of the dynamics of biomolecules decoupled from solvent effects. Lyophilised sucrose exhibited steadily increasing absorption with temperature as anharmonic excitations commence as the system emerges from a deep minimum of the potential energy landscape where harmonic vibrations dominate.

arxiv-2310-03509.title: Exploring the Hubble Tension: A Novel Approach through Cosmological Observations
arxiv-2310-03509.creator: Darshan Kumar, Debajyoti Choudhury, Debottam Nandi
arxiv-2310-03509.description: Abstract The simplest cosmological model ( Λ \Lambda CDM) is well-known to suffer from the Hubble tension, namely an almost 5 ​ σ 5\sigma discrepancy between the (model-based) early-time determination of the Hubble constant H 0 H_{0} and its late-time (and model-independent) determination.

arxiv-2407-08338.title: Bounds in a popular multidimensional nonlinear Roth theorem
arxiv-2407-08338.creator: Sarah Peluse, Sean Prendiville, Xuancheng Shao
arxiv-2407-08338.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sarah Peluse, Sean Prendiville, Xuancheng Shao. A nonlinear version of Roth’s theorem states that dense sets of integers contain configurations of the form x x , x + d x+d , x + d 2 x+d^{2} . We obtain a multidimensional version of this result, which can be regarded as a first step towards effectivising those cases of the multidimensional polynomial Szemerédi theorem involving polynomials with distinct degrees.

arxiv-2408-00715.title: The Inevitable Quark Three-Body Force and its Implications for Exotic States
arxiv-2408-00715.creator: Sungsik Noh, Aaron Park, Hyeongock Yun, Sungtae Cho, Su Houng Lee
arxiv-2408-00715.description: Abstract Three-body nuclear forces are essential for explaining the properties of light nuclei with a nucleon number greater than three. Building on insights from nuclear physics, we extract the form of quark three-body interactions and demonstrate that these terms are crucial for extending the quark model fit of the meson spectrum to include baryons using the same parameter set.

arxiv-2501-17607.title: XRISM observations of the cooling flow cluster A2029 support heating by mixing
arxiv-2501-17607.creator: Noam Soker
arxiv-2501-17607.description: Abstract I argue that the mixing-heating mechanism of the intracluster medium (ICM) is compatible with the new observations by the X-ray telescope XRISM that show the dispersion velocity in the cooling flow cluster of galaxies A2029 to be σ v = 169 ± 10 ​ km ​ s − 1 \sigma_{v}=169\pm 10{~\rm km}{~\rm s}^{-1} .

arxiv-2504-13493.title: Slow uniform flow of a rarefied gas past an infinitely thin circular disk
arxiv-2504-13493.creator: Takuma Tomita \aff 1, Satoshi Taguchi \aff 1, Tetsuro Tsuji \aff 1
arxiv-2504-13493.description: Abstract The classical problem of steady rarefied gas flow past an infinitely thin circular disk is revisited, with particular emphasis on the gas behavior near the disk edge. The uniform flow is assumed to be perpendicular to the disk surface.

arxiv-2511-19660.title: Optical and cm follow-ups of the Changing-Look event in Mkn 590 Publication type: PROCEEDING
arxiv-2511-19660.creator: Biswaraj Palit*, Abhijeet Borkar, Agata Różańska, Alex Markowitz, Marzena Śniegowska, Swayamtrupta Panda, David Homan, Krystian Iłkiewicz
arxiv-2511-19660.description: Abstract The Changing-Look active galactic nucleus Mkn 590 is currently in a rejuvenated state, exhibiting a contemporaneous flux rise across X-rays, UV, optical and cm wavelengths. In this study, we present three new optical spectra obtained with the Nordic Optical Telescope, alongside three 1.4 GHz continuum measurements from the Giant Meterwave Radio Telescope, acquired since Nov. 2024.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-epistle-to-th.title: Epistle to the Colossians (Catholic Encyclopedia article)
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-epistle-to-th.creator: Cornelius Aherne
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-epistle-to-th.description: Article 'Epistle to the Colossians' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10617803.title: Animal Models of Kidney Disease: Challenges and Perspectives
pmc-10617803.creator: Jianqing Liang, Youhua Liu
pmc-10617803.description: Kidney disease is highly prevalent and affects approximately 850 million people worldwide. It is also associated with high morbidity and mortality, and current therapies are incurable and often ineffective. Animal models are indispensable for understanding the pathophysiology of various kidney diseases and for preclinically testing novel remedies.

pmc-10672918.title: Synthesis of Imidazole-Compound-Coated Copper Nanoparticles with Promising Antioxidant and Sintering Properties
pmc-10672918.creator: Yu Zhang, Xianchong Yu, Ziyuan Chen, Song Wu, Haiqi Lai, Shiwo Ta, Tingyu Lin, Guannan Yang, Chengqiang Cui
pmc-10672918.description: In this study, we present a facile method for preparing oxidation-resistant Cu nanoparticles through a liquid-phase reduction with imidazole compounds (imidazole, 2-methylimidazole, 2-phenylimidazole, and benzimidazole) that serve as protective and dispersing agents. Through a complexation reaction between Cu atoms, the imidazole compounds can form a protective film on the Cu nanoparticles to prevent the particles from rapidly oxidizing.

pmc-11475967.title: Deep Learning for Parkinson’s Disease Diagnosis: A Graph Neural Network (GNN) Based Classification Approach with Graph Wavelet Transform (GWT) Using Protein–Peptide Datasets
pmc-11475967.creator: Prabhavathy Mohanraj, Valliappan Raman, Saveeth Ramanathan
pmc-11475967.description: Background: An important neurological disorder of Parkinson’s Disease (PD) is characterized by motor and non-motor activity of the patients. Empirical condition of the patient: PD assessment uses the Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson’s Rating Scale part III (MDS-UPDRS-III) measures for identifying the prediction of PD.

pmc-11556112.title: Complete genome sequence of a potentially probiotic cheese isolate Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LP140 from the Nordbiotic collection
pmc-11556112.creator: Agnieszka Szczepankowska, Bożena Cukrowska, Tamara Aleksandrzak-Piekarczyk
pmc-11556112.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We report the complete genome sequence of Lactiplantibacillus plantarum LP140, a cheese isolate from the Nordbiotic collection, comprising 3,371,266 bp with 44.4% GC content. Our data provide insight into the potential of LP140 for use as a probiotic strain. ANNOUNCEMENT

Lactiplantibacillus plantarum belongs to gram-positive lactic acid bacteria, which are used as starter strains for fermented foods as well as probiotics, providing beneficial health effects to consumers (1–4). plantarum LP140, originally isolated from cheese, was acquired by Nordic Biotic LTD.

pmc-11600583.title: Assessment of tibialis anterior tendon insertion variations in relation to hallux valgus utilizing magnetic resonance imaging
pmc-11600583.creator: Fatih Uğur, Mehmet Albayrak, Bedrettin Akar, Bahadir Reis
pmc-11600583.description: BackgroundHallux valgus is a deformity characterized by lateral deviation of the big toe and medial deviation of the first metatarsal, causing difficulty in walking and requiring various treatments. Despite its multifactorial etiology, the role of the tibialis anterior tendon in hallux valgus and its variations in the morphology of tibialis anterior tendon distal insertion sites have not been fully explored.

pmc-11716640.title: Evaluating impact of racialization on imaging and plasma biomarkers
pmc-11716640.creator: Alexandra Gogola, Xuemei Zeng, Anum Saeed, Brian J Lopresti, Beth E Snitz, Dana Tudorascu, Davneet S Minhas, Milos D Ikonomovic, Julia Kofler, Cristy Matan, Neale S Mason, Tharick A Pascoal, Howard J Aizenstein, Chester Mathis, William E Klunk, Henrik Zetterberg, Kaj Blennow, Oscar L Lopez, Steven E
pmc-11716640.description: BackgroundImaging and plasma biomarkers are widely used in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) observational studies and clinical trials. Due to the lack of racial or ethnic diversity in earlier studies, a more complete understanding of biomarker differences across racialized groups is needed.

pmc-11744382.title: Analysis of Current Status and Influencing Factors of Psychological Distress Tolerance in Liver Cancer Patients after Interventional Therapy
pmc-11744382.creator: Li Yang, Liuyin Zhou, Chaofu Zhao, Lingdan Lan, Chao Ji, Jianfei Tu, Weidan Xu
pmc-11744382.description: BackgroundInterventional therapy, currently, has become a major method for the clinical treatment of liver cancer patients. However, interventional therapy can also lead to various toxic side effects, and combined with the impact of the disease itself, liver cancer patients often experience more severe emotional distress.

pmc-12638859.title: RNF115 upregulation by YBX1-dependent m5C modification promotes hepatocellular carcinoma progression
pmc-12638859.creator: Jianhao Li, Han Chen, Lang Bai, Hong Tang
pmc-12638859.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). 5-methylcytosine (m5C) RNA modification plays critical roles in post-transcriptional regulation and cancer progression. However, the downstream effectors of the m5C reader protein YBX1 and their mechanistic contribution to hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remain largely undefined. In this study, we performed transcriptome-wide m5C profiling and observed significant heterogeneity in m5C modification patterns in HCC, with differentially methylated genes broadly distributed across the genome except for chromosome Y. We found that YBX1 is markedly upregulated in HCC and significantly correlated with poor patient prognosis.

pmc-12714168.title: SphK1 Suppresses Human Dental Pulp Stem Cell Apoptosis by Promoting Glycolysis Under Simulated Microgravity
pmc-12714168.creator: Jingyi Che, Zhengjun Qiu, Huailong Hou, Yanping Li, Lina He, Jingxuan Sun, Shuang Zhang, Mengdi Li, Shuang Pan, Weiwei Zhang, Yumei Niu
pmc-12714168.description: Glycolysis supports mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) proliferation and sustains their undifferentiated state by maintaining energy supply and limiting apoptosis. The rapid advancement of space life sciences has spurred considerable interest in the effects of microgravity on stem cells. However, the contribution of glycolytic metabolism to apoptotic regulation under simulated microgravity (SMG) remains unclear.

pmc-12751606.title: Improving protein interaction prediction in GenPPi: a novel interaction sampling approach preserving network topology
pmc-12751606.creator: Alisson Silva, Carlos Marquez, Iury Godoy, Lucas Silva, Matheus Prado, Murilo Beppler, Natanael Avila, Bruno Travençolo, Anderson R. Santos
pmc-12751606.description: BackgroundComputational prediction of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) is crucial for understanding cell biology and drug development, offering an alternative to costly experimental methods. The original GenPPi software advanced ab initio PPI network prediction from bacterial genomes but was limited by its reliance on high sequence similarity. This work introduces GenPPi 1.5 to enhance these predictive capabilities.ResultsGenPPi 1.

pmc-13203643.title: Antimicrobial Resistance in Pediatric UTIs with Congenital Urogenital Anomalies: An 11-Year Saudi Retrospective Study
pmc-13203643.creator: Fuad Alanazi, Basmah M. Almaarik
pmc-13203643.description: Background/Objectives: Children with congenital urogenital anomalies (CUA) face increased risk of urinary tract infections (UTIs) and may harbor resistant organisms due to recurrent infections and antibiotic exposure. This study characterized the distribution of uropathogens and antimicrobial resistance patterns at a tertiary center in Saudi Arabia.

pmc-13281692.title: Curriculum Mapping as a Tool for Faculty Support, Reflection, and Curricular Integration
pmc-13281692.creator: Enzo Moreira da Silva, Marcela Charantola Rodrigues
pmc-13281692.description: tives, and curricular responsibilities. Such uncertainty may lead to frustration and weaken the teaching–learning process. In 2023, the School of Dentistry, University of University of São Paulo (FOUSP) implemented a new integrated curriculum, revealing these challenges within the Dental Biomaterials discipline. Faculty members reported difficulty identifying where and how their content would appear in the revised curriculum.

pmc-13289201.title: Self-care needs of patients with coronary heart disease in Islamabad, Pakistan: cohort study protocol
pmc-13289201.creator: Gideon Victor, Erika Sivarajan Froelicher, Ercole Vellone

pmc-13318491.title: Long-term drug persistence and clinical outcomes of ustekinumab in Crohn’s disease: a multicenter real-world study from the Hokkaido phoenix cohort
pmc-13318491.creator: Takahiro Ito, Atsuo Maemoto, Nobuhiro Ueno, Mikihiro Fujiya, Toshifumi Ashida, Daisuke Hirayama, Yoshihiro Yokoyama, Satoshi Motoya, Masanao Nasuno, Hiroki Tanaka, Takehiko Katsurada, Hiroshi Nakase
pmc-13318491.description: BackgroundAlthough ustekinumab (UST) is effective in Crohn’s disease (CD), long-term real-world data beyond 5 years and its effects on extraintestinal manifestations remain limited. We evaluated UST’s long-term effectiveness and safety in CD.MethodsThis multicenter retrospective study enrolled 317 CD patients who initiated UST between May 2017 and February 2023 at seven institutions in Japan.

pmc-13371524.title: Prognostic value of lymphovascular invasion and CEA for cancer-specific survival in octogenarian colorectal cancer patients
pmc-13371524.creator: Xiuping Weng, Yangyang Zhou, Yunzhu Zhang, Xiexi Fang, Rongbin Xu, Yiqiang Wang, Qi Qiu, Xiaoyuan Chen
pmc-13371524.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the prognostic value of lymphovascular invasion (LVI) and preoperative carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) level for cancer-specific survival (CSS) in octogenarian (≥ 80 years) colorectal cancer (CRC) patients, and to explore the modifying effects of tumor laterality and histological subtype on this prognostic value.

pmc-13530774.title: Poster 183. Prevalence of Reported Penicillin Allergy and Severe Reactions in Patients Given Cefazolin in Consecutive Cohort of an Elective Orthopedic Surgical Practice
pmc-13530774.creator: Albert Lin, Abigail Balsan, Camila Grandberg
pmc-13530774.description: Objective:Cefazolin is the most effective prophylactic preoperative antibiotic by far, and literature has shown that the cross reactivity between penicillin and cefazolin administration is extremely low. Penicillin allergies are prevalently reported which causes a reluctance or refusal to use cefazolin in these patients leading them to receive inferior antibiotics.

pmc-13672733.title: Synthesis of selenium particles using Durio zibethinus seed extract
pmc-13672733.creator: Linh Doan, Quynh N Le, Quynh LK Ong, Khanh G Huynh, Ngoc HY Le, Anh T K Nguyen
pmc-13672733.description: The average particle sizes of selenium particles (SeP) synthesized using Durio zibethinus seed extract (DZSE) and Durio zibethinus husk extract (DZHE) were 40.1 ± 11.4 nm and 47.7 ± 13.6 nm, respectively. The antimicrobial efficacy of SeP was assessed against Staphylococcus aureus (SA), Pseudomonas aeruginosa (PA), Salmonella enterica (SE), and Escherichia coli (Ec).

uslaw-usc-t42-s19271.title: 42 U.S.C. § 19271 — Establishment of blockchain and cryptocurrency specialist position within OSTP
uslaw-usc-t42-s19271.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s19271.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 163 (Research And Development, Competition, And Innovation); Subchapter VI (Miscellaneous Science And Technology Provisions); Part F (Blockchain Specialist). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Director of the Office of Science and Technology Policy shall establish or designate a blockchain and cryptocurrencies advisory specialist position within the Office to coordinate Federal activities.
